title: Complete sequential procedure
source: The clerk performs Receive request as the starting step. The clerk then performs Archive request, which ends the process.

title: Approval without a rejection route
source: The manager performs Review request as the starting step. If approved, the clerk performs Archive request, which ends the process. No next step is defined when the request is rejected.

title: Procedure stops before completion
source: The clerk performs Receive request as the starting step. The clerk then performs Check request. Check request is not an end state, has no next step, and no completed outcome is defined.

title: Approval and rejection both terminate
source: The manager performs Review claim as the starting step. If approved, the clerk performs Pay claim, which ends the process. Otherwise, the clerk performs Reject claim, which ends the process.

title: Action has no named responsible person
source: Receive parcel is the starting step, and no responsible actor is specified. Next, the clerk performs Store parcel, which ends the process.

title: Disconnected activity has no entry route
source: The clerk performs Open ticket as the starting step. The clerk then performs Close ticket, which ends the process. The auditor performs Audit ticket as a separate terminal step; no transition leads to Audit ticket from Open ticket or Close ticket.

title: Urgent route bypasses mandatory review
source: The clerk performs Receive order as the starting step. For routine orders, the manager performs Review order, then the clerk performs Dispatch order, which ends the process. For urgent orders, the clerk goes directly from Receive order to Dispatch order. Every dispatch must pass through Review order before Dispatch order, including urgent orders.

title: Retry cycle has no route to completion
source: The clerk performs Receive file as the starting step. The clerk then performs Check file. From Check file, the clerk always performs Retry check, then returns to Check file. Neither Check file nor Retry check is a terminal step, and no completion step exists.

title: Explicit failure route is preserved
source: The technician performs Test device as the starting step. If the test succeeds, the technician performs Release device, which ends the process. If the test fails, the technician performs Quarantine device, which ends the process.
